column2: then write to raid array disks. If

column1: crash happens

column1: raid resync and fix write hole issue.

unit

column1: The meta data block can track 3 types of data
parity and flush block. MD superblock will point to the last valid

data/parity to the metadata block
column2: so meta data and stripe data/parity

column1: can be written to log disk together. otherwise
wait till stripe data/parity is finished.

column2: but this format can be extended to support

column1: caching in the future

column2: meta data block will record stripe sector. It's
